author: GameTrailers
description:
Deck of Haunts gets a new trailer and a console release date. Check out the latest Deck of Haunts trailer to see gameplay and more from this sinister deckbuilding roguelike game, where players become a malevolent haunted house. New additions to the console release include new cards and rooms, new starter decks and creative deck building, missions, story, and meta-progression, expanded room-building and human navigation, nightmare mode and the Grim Reaper, new creatures, curated scenarios, and more quality-of-life features and controller improvements.

Deck of Haunts will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, and Xbox Series X|S on October 8, 2026. It is already available on PC.
title: Deck of Haunts - Official Console Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out gameplay from Firefighters: Code Red in this latest trailer for the upcoming firefighting simulation game. Firefighters: Code Red will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S.

Firefighters: Code Red puts you on the front line of unpredictable emergencies across more than 30 North American-inspired mission locations. You will enter burning buildings, search for trapped civilians and tackle dynamic fires in which smoke, heat, structural instability, backdrafts and hazardous materials can quickly transform a routine call.
title: Firefighters: Code Red - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Chapter 1 Rework Launch Trailer for A.A.U. Black Site, a first-person psychological horror action shooter developed by Raspberry Studio. Players can check out new updates to Chapter 1, including controller support, new enemy AI behavior, horror encounters, and more. The Chapter 1 Rework for A.A.U. Black Site is available now for PC (Steam).
title: A.A.U. Black Site - Official Chapter 1 Rework Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at Dark Trip in this trailer for the gothic horror escape room where you use wicked biomachinery, strange art and your own hallucinations to solve the mystery of an eerie crime. Explore strange rooms, inspect occult locations and laboratory machines, reveal hidden clues through altered visions. Play flat or in VR. Dark Trip is available now in Early Access on Meta, and a demo is coming to Steam on September 25, 2026.
title: Dark Trip - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for Fangtopia, a city-building turn-based strategy game developed by Absolutely Games. Players will lay tiles down to assemble magical landscapes and construct the highest-scoring kingdom of them all. Complete objectives and expand the kingdom in Fangtopia, coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Fangtopia - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a fresh look at Pera Coda in this latest trailer for the upcoming episodic murder-mystery adventure set in a dark reflection of Istanbul in a time before mobile phones and the internet. Pera Coda will be available on PC via Steam, with the first episode scheduled for 2027.

A murder the authorities want buried. A conspiracy of gangsters, businessmen, and corporate power reaching into organized crime. Every conversation is evidence. Every silence is a choice.
title: Pera Coda - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for Neuromana, a side-scrolling action arcade shooter developed by Two Toads Team. Players will shoot through a 90s aesthetic across the city of Manapolis to rid it of lawlessness, corruption, and violence that infect the city itslef. Neuromana is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Neuromana - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Core Map Reveal Trailer for Tyr, an action tank-based multiplayer game developed by Stoke Games. Players can fight in the dead of night on the new map called Core, where teams can descend on the enemy under the cover of darkness. Core is available now in Tyr for PC (Steam).
title: Tyr - Official Core Map Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Wave One 2000s Legends Gameplay Trailer for NBA The Run, an arcade basketball simulation game developed by Play by Play Studios. Players will take to the streets in 3v3 basketball games to compete for the top spot. A new update is bringing iconic players from the 2000s, with Allen Iverson, Vince Carter, Tracy McGrady, Kevin Garnett, and Dirk Nowitzki joining the game. The Wave One 2000s Legends Update is launching on September 29 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: NBA The Run - Official Wave One 2000s Legends Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the PS5 Release Date Trailer for BeamNG.drive, a hyper-realistic driving simulation game developed by BeamNG. Players will leverage soft-body vehicles to take scenic drives across open-world environments with extensively customizable vehicles. BeamNG.drive is launching on October 19 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), with the game available now for PC (Steam).
title: BeamNG.drive - Official PS5 Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Playtest Trailer for Ghost Eater, an upcoming third-person hack-and-slash action game developed by Greenbullet. Players will explore a manga-inspired world to take on enemies, defeat bosses, and utilize a suite of skills. Ghost Eater is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a playtest available now on Steam.
title: Ghost Eater - Official Playtest Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Blue Lock Event Launch Trailer for Rematch, the hit football (soccer) action game developed by Sloclap. Players can dive into all-new experiences with Aura Striker, a new limited-time 3v3 game mode, to progress through the Event Pass by challenge completion. Secure new Blue Lock cosmetics with the new bundle featuring new looks for Yoichi Isagi, Meguru Bachira, Seishiro Nagi, and Rin Itoshi. The Blue Lock Event is available now for Rematch on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Rematch X Blue Lock - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Tune in to the Big Break Showcase airing September 29, 2026 at 19:00 CEST / 18:00 GMT / 13:00 EDT / 10:00 PDT! The Big Break Showcase is a gathering of indie game developers and publishers who have some new and fun things to share! The show features new announcements from Deep Rock Galactic, Goat Simulator, Lightyear Frontier, Teardown and Satisfactory – alongside new indie game reveals and news and updates from our friends at other indie publishers.

#IGN
title: The Big Break Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Chapter 1 Release Date Teaser Trailer for Hytale, a creation adventure game developed by Hypixel Studios. Players can get a look at the new dungeon, multi-phase boss fight, a new Goblin faction, and more to explore. Interact with the Goblin Breach world event, goblin gadgets, the new Rune Abilities system, and more in Chapter 1 of Hytale, launching on October 12 for PC.
title: Hytale - Official Chapter 1 Release Date Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the DOOM Event Pass for Call of Duty: Black Ops 7, the latest installment in the first-person shooter developed by Treyarch. Players can progress through the DOOM Event Pass to unlock the Doom Slayer, Classic Doomguy, and rewards like the Crucible Blade and DOOM Shotgun. The Doom Event Pass is available now for Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.
title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 x DOOM - Official Event Pass Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the'Future of Marathon' Vidoc Part 1 for Marathon, a first-person extraction shooter developed by Bungie. Players can get a behind-the-scenes look at where Marathon is, and most importantly, where Marathon is headed with the Symbiosis Update in December and the evolution of the game in March 2027. Get a look at what's to come, including PvE, an experimental Team Deathmatch mode, a new Bishop Runner Shell, a social space, an expanded Perimeter, and more. Marathon is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Marathon - Official 'Future of Marathon' Part 1 Overview

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Carnival Season 1 Trailer for Mistfall Hunter, a dark fantasy extraction action RPG developed by Bellring Games. Players can get a look at the Season Carnival Event, with Combat Bags, Legendary Material Selection Chests, rewards, and more. Carnival Season 1 for Mistfall Hunter kicks off on September 30 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Mistfall Hunter - Official Carnival Season 1 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the League Mode Update Launch Trailer for eFootball Kick Off!, the hit football (soccer) simulation game developed by Konami. Players can now choose from 25 global leagues to compete for the title. Bring home the win in League Mode for eFootball Kick Off!, available now for Nintendo Switch 2.
title: eFootball Kick Off! - Official League Mode Update Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Mobile Launch Trailer for Gothic Classic, a return of the legendary third-person action RPG developed by Piranha Bytes. Players will make decisions and allies as the Nameless Hero to traverse the Valley of Mines, dispatch enemies with an array of weaponry, and harness magic-based abilities. Gothic Classic is available now on iOS alongside PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Gothic Classic - Official Mobile Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Frozen Trail Teaser Trailer for ARC Raiders, a third-person action extraction shooter developed by Embark Studios. Players will head north, where no Raider has gone before, with the upcoming Frozen Trail Update packed with a whole new frigid map to take on, new ARC enemies to dispatch, and more to discover. The Frozen Trail Update for ARC Raiders is launching on October 8 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: ARC Raiders - Official Frozen Trail Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Mars Attracts, the park management sim set in the universe of the cult-classic film Mars Attacks, is launching its 1.0 version today. Check it out on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2760580/Mars_Attracts/
title: Mars Attracts! – Official 1.0 Version Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: The third free Caldera Chronicles level, the Bouncy Castle, is available now for PC, Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2. Watch the latest PowerWash Simulator 2 trailer to see the mess you'll have to clean up with this new Bouncy Castle level.
title: PowerWash Simulator 2 - Official Caldera Chronicles: Bouncy Castle Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Echoes of Central Park Expansion Gameplay Overview Trailer for The Division 2, the hit third-person action shooter developed by Ubisoft. Players will explore the narrative of what happened to the iconic Central Park after the Dollar Flu struck New York. Aid companions to aid in the fight, take on missions to secure Control Points, and tend to the fears in the city. The Echoes of Central Park Expansion is launching on November 3 for The Division 2 on PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox One, and PC (Steam).
title: The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park - Official Expansion Gameplay Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park announcement trailer for the upcoming DLC for the third-person action shooter game. The new DLC takes you to the Upper West Side and Central Park in NYC, and the trailer gives you a glimpse of the story, locations, and what to expect. The Division 2 is out now on PC and consoles. The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park DLC will be available on November 3, 2026.
title: The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park - Official DLC Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Phoenix Wright and Apollo Justice are returning to the cour room, but this time, in VR! Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Dual Destinies VR is the brand new entry in the Ace Attorney series, developed by AMATA K.K and published by Capcom. Cross-examine, press the witness and of course prepare the signature OBJECTION! when Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Dual Destinies VR launches for Meta VR Glasses, Meta Quest 3/3S, Quest Pro, and Quest2 in 2027.
title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Dual Destinies VR - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the 'Fortnitemares' Teaser Trailer for Fortnite, the hit third-person action battle royale shooter developed by Epic Games. Players will witness the start of the spooky season as Fortnitemares is announced via a cryptic trailer with unsettling scenes and visuals of true horror. Learn more about Fortnitmares for Fortnite on October 1.
title: Fortnite - Official 'Fortnitemares' Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the Rip It! Card Collector announcement trailer for the upcoming card collection sim where you open and sort packs, and also go on the hunt to find rare ones. Rip It! Card Collector will be available on PC.
title: Rip It! Card Collector - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Teaser Trailer for the Out of Bounds 2026 Showcase, an upcoming indie video game announcement show produced by Entalto Publishing. Discover new global talent and unannounced projects in development across the indie space, from roguelikes to simulation games. The Out of Bounds 2026 Showcase airs on October 6.
title: Out of Bounds 2026 Showcase - Official Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the new release date trailer for No Such Place, the upcoming top-down, pixel-art, retro-styled extraction shooter for 1-4 players in which you and your friends must explore and ultimately escape the Unknown Research Consortium. It will launch into Steam Early Access on October 14. Wishlist it and/or play the demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3299050/No_Such_Place/
title: No Such Place: Official Early Access Release Date Trailer
